name: pretty-bugz
description: A modern look for bugzilla.mozilla.org with light and dark modes, plus redesigned pages: bugs with a sticky field rail, a one-page new-bug form, filterable bug lists, a live advanced-search summary, regroupable requests and a compact history log.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run lint && web-ext build && node tools/check-package.mjs
scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --channel unlisted
